cards.text: The Israelites are about to get their portions of the land of Canaan. Handing them out are Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, Israel's leader, and the heads of the families of the tribes. Picture dividing up one cookie tray for a whole NATION, friend, with everybody leaning in to see who gets the corner piece.

cards.question: True or false: The land for the nine and a half tribes is assigned by lot, as the LORD commanded through Moses, Israel's leader before Joshua.

cards.text: Why nine and a half? Moses already gave the other two and a half tribes their land east of the Jordan, and Joseph's descendants became two tribes, Manasseh and Ephraim, so Joseph basically showed up with a plus-one.

cards.question: One tribe is different. The Levites get no portion of the land, except ___ to live in, along with ___ for their flocks and herds.

cards.text: So the Israelites divide the land, just as the LORD commanded Moses. That's one BIG tray, friend, and it's getting cut.

Then the sons of Judah come to Joshua at Gilgal, and Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, one of Judah's own, walks up like someone who held onto his receipt: "You know what the LORD said to Moses the man of God at Kadesh-barnea about you and me."

cards.question: Caleb was forty years old when Moses sent him from Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land. Caleb says he brought Moses back an ___ report.
True or false: Caleb says he joined the other spies in making the hearts of the people melt with fear.

cards.text: The other spies had the people's hearts melting like chocolate chips on a hot tray, but Caleb remained loyal to the LORD his God. He says that on that day, Moses swore to him that the land his feet had touched would be an inheritance for him and his children forever.

cards.question: Why does Moses promise Caleb that land?

answers.text: Because Caleb followed the LORD completely
Because Caleb was the oldest of the spies
Because Caleb went ahead of the other spies

cards.text: Caleb says that, as the LORD promised, He has kept him alive forty-five years since then, while Israel wandered in the wilderness. Forty-five YEARS holding onto a promise, and I stare at a twelve-minute oven timer like it owes me money.

cards.question: Caleb was forty when Moses sent him to spy. Add those forty-five years. How old is Caleb now?
True or false: At eighty-five, Caleb says he's still as strong as he was the day Moses sent him out.

cards.text: Strong for war, for going out and for coming in, and now Caleb makes his ask: give him the hill country the LORD promised him on that day, since Joshua heard back then who was living up there. Friend, they slid ME into a junk drawer when my edges went soft, and this man wants the HILL COUNTRY.

cards.question: Who does Caleb say lives in the hill country he's asking Joshua for?
The Anakim in that hill country have great and fortified cities. How does Caleb say he might drive them out?
Joshua blesses Caleb son of Jephunneh and gives him ___ as his inheritance.

cards.text: Hebron belongs to Caleb to this day, because he wholly followed the LORD, the God of Israel. And get this: Hebron used to be called Kiriath-arba, after a man named Arba.

cards.question: Who was Arba, the man Kiriath-arba was named after?

answers.text: The greatest man among the Anakim

cards.text: Then the land had rest from war. Caleb held onto one promise for forty-five years, and here it is, friend, with his name on it.
